_about: Season edges settled by hand from the two readers' output (rules/season_calendar.json) and the post text, 2026-11-08. Each date is what the operations blog ANNOUNCED or reported, with its post id; 'announced' means a plan, not proof it happened. The operators' own tweet rosters still decide the real first and last operating day (decision 29 union). Conflicts between readers were settled by taking the latest post that states the date and is not cancelled. 'vs_season_windows' says how it compares with rules/season_windows.json (same / new / differs).
rule: latest non-cancelled statement wins; a retrospective statement beats an earlier plan; single-reader facts are marked
